basic_details.job_title: DGMS Young Professionals Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS), Dhanbad, a subordinate office under the Ministry of Labour & Employment, Govt. of India, is engaging one Young Professional (Media Cell) from the open market on a purely contractual basis up to February, 2027, at Rs. 60,000/- per month (Consolidated inclusive of all). Candidates need a Master degree in Mass Communication or Journalism or Public Relations or Mass Multimedia & Communications, must be below 32 years of age as on the date of advertisement, and must send the Annexure-A application form by post or by email so that it reaches within 15

age_limit.details: The guidelines for engagement of Young Professionals on https://dgms.gov.in also contain the eligibility criteria; candidates should check the official notification and those guidelines for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

qualification.details: Master degree in Mass Communication or Journalism or Public Relations or Mass Multimedia & Communications.

how_to_apply: Fill in the prescribed Application Form (Annexure-A) printed with the notice, with a recent passport size photograph in the space given.
Answer the form's declarations on any pending criminal case, any conviction by a court, and any conflict of interest or pecuniary interest, giving details at the end where the answer is yes.
Sign the declaration and enclose the documents listed below.
Send the application by post to: The Director of Mines Safety(SD), Directorate General of Mines Safety, Hirapur, Dhanbad – 826 001 (Jharkhand).
Or send it by email to [email protected].
Make sure the application reaches within 15 days from the date of publish of the advertisement; applications received after the due date will not be considered.
Recent passport size photograph (on the form)
Educational Qualification from Secondary onwards (copy of certificate/mark sheet)
important_instructions: The guidelines for engagement of Young Professionals, with the eligibility criteria and selection procedure, are on https://dgms.gov.in, and the notice advises candidates to go through them before applying. The form asks for experience of the last 10 years, assignment-wise; a separate sheet may be annexed. If information is found false, incorrect or incomplete, or ineligibility is detected at any time before or after selection/interview, candidature is liable to be rejected. Applicants accept all the terms and conditions for engagement of Consultants/YPs and are bound by the decision of the Directorate General of Mines Safety.

content_sections.heading: DGMS Young Professionals (YPs) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or the selection process; it states that the selection procedure is given in the DGMS guidelines for engagement of Young Professionals on its website.

rows.details: Directorate General of Mines Safety (DGMS), Ministry of Labour & Employment, Govt. of India
Purely contractual, fixed period upto February, 2027
Rs. 60,000/- per month (Consolidated inclusive of all)
Below 32 years of age as on the date of advertisement
By post or by email (Application Form, Annexure-A)
Within 15 days from the date of publish of the advertisement – about 21 November 2026 (15 days from 06 November 2026)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master degree in Mass Communication or Journalism or Public Relations or Mass Multimedia & Communications. Minimum 1 year of professional work experience as a Communication Professional having excellent skills in: handling social media (All Platforms); copywriting and proofreading; content creation, photo and video-editing; using tools and techniques to increase the visibility of the Organization; using multimedia; proficiency in Microsoft Office Packages, Adobe illustrator, in Design, Canvas, Photoshop etc. Persons with post qualification experience in the relevant field would be preferred. The guidelines for engagement of Young Professionals on https://dgms.gov.in also contain the eligibility criteria; candidates should check the official notification and those guidelines for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration is Rs. 60,000/- per month, consolidated and inclusive of all. The method of recruitment is contract based through open market. The engagement is purely on contractual basis for a fixed period, i.e. upto February, 2027. Being a contractual arrangement, the engagement could be terminated at any time by the competent authority without assigning any reasons. Remuneration, allowances, age limit, leave, working hours, period of engagement as YP etc. will be governed by the guidelines for engagement of Young Professionals available on the DGMS website.

content_sections.heading: DGMS Young Professionals (YPs) Job Description
content_sections.text: Under "Nature of Duties", the notice states: Young Professionals will work as assigned to them.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DGMS Young Professionals (YPs)
content_sections.text: Recent passport size photograph (on the form) Educational Qualification from Secondary onwards (copy of certificate/mark sheet) Detailed CV Last Salary slip Work Experience Certificate

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The guidelines for engagement of Young Professionals, with the eligibility criteria and selection procedure, are on https://dgms.gov.in , and the notice advises candidates to go through them before applying. The form asks for experience of the last 10 years, assignment-wise; a separate sheet may be annexed. If information is found false, incorrect or incomplete, or ineligibility is detected at any time before or after selection/interview, candidature is liable to be rejected. Applicants accept all the terms and conditions for engagement of Consultants/YPs and are bound by the decision of the Directorate General of Mines Safety.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DGMS Young Professional Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) position of Young Professional, for the Media Cell of the Directorate General of Mines Safety.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the DGMS Young Professional post?
faq.answer: Applications should reach within 15 days from the date of publish of the advertisement dated 06 November 2026, which is about 21 November 2026. Applications received after the due date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for DGMS Young Professional (Media Cell)?
faq.answer: A Master degree in Mass Communication or Journalism or Public Relations or Mass Multimedia & Communications is essential, along with minimum 1 year of professional work experience as a Communication Professional.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the DGMS Young Professional post?
faq.answer: Candidates should be below 32 years of age as on the date of advertisement, 06 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a DGMS Young Professional?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 60,000/- per month, consolidated and inclusive of all.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the DGMS Young Professional post?
faq.answer: Fill the Application Form (Annexure-A) and send it by post to The Director of Mines Safety(SD), Directorate General of Mines Safety, Hirapur, Dhanbad – 826 001 (Jharkhand), or by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Is the DGMS Young Professional job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on contractual basis for a fixed period upto February, 2027, and could be terminated at any time by the competent authority without assigning any reasons.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be enclosed with the DGMS Young Professional application?
faq.answer: Enclose educational qualification documents from Secondary onwards, a detailed CV, the last salary slip and a work experience certificate, with a recent passport size photograph on the form.

faq.question: Q9. What skills does DGMS want for the Young Professional (Media Cell) post?
faq.answer: The experience must include handling social media (All Platforms), copywriting and proofreading, content creation, photo and video-editing, multimedia, and proficiency in Microsoft Office Packages, Adobe illustrator, in Design, Canvas, Photoshop etc.
